autopilot_build.purpose: Agent-facing validate, preflight, run, and report loop for a workflow task.

okf_validate.purpose: Validate the local Open Knowledge Format bundle before finishing docs, schema, CLI, skill, hook, or agent policy changes.

okf_generate_indexes.purpose: Regenerate OKF directory indexes from concept frontmatter after editing docs/okf concepts.

copilot_build.purpose: Start a phase-by-phase copilot automation build and ask the intake question.

copilot_session.purpose: Read copilot session state, questions, answers, artifacts, and linked run evidence.

copilot_answer.purpose: Answer the active copilot question and continue or stop the session.

copilot_advance.purpose: Advance the copilot session through discovery, validation, preflight, safe run, and review.

copilot_auto.purpose: Agent-owned one-shot automation builder loop. Starts the session, auto-confirms intake from the prompt, runs safe phases, and stops only at a question or review gate.

copilot_try_url.purpose: Fast URL iteration path. Creates a task, reuses discovery cache when safe, validates, preflights, runs, and writes one copilot report.

validate_yaml.purpose: Validate workflow schema and success checks before execution.

preflight_yaml.purpose: Run preflight checks without executing workflow actions.

run_yaml.purpose: Execute a deterministic workflow and produce run artifacts.

browser_selector_swarm.purpose: Discover and validate browser selectors from page evidence.

repair_selector.purpose: Create or apply selector repair from failure evidence.

retry_failed_records.purpose: Retry only failed records marked safe to retry.
